brief.description: Build a small React and Express prototype for a university study-room booking system. Students can see available rooms, book a time slot, and cancel their own bookings. Prevent overlapping reservations. Deliver a local demonstration and a short setup guide; no payments or production deployment are required.

modules.name: Backend API
modules.description: Express server with local state data management for study room slots.

modules.name: Frontend Interface
modules.description: React UI for viewing available rooms and managing user bookings.

tasks.title: Define room and booking data schema
tasks.description: Deliverable: JSON structure representing rooms and bookings. Steps: Define schema to support room ID, time slots, and unique user identifiers. Ensure schema handles null booking statuses. Done when: Schema successfully represents 3 rooms with 5 slots each and validates against overlapping logic constraints.

tasks.title: Initialize Express API endpoints
tasks.description: Deliverable: REST API endpoints for GET/POST/DELETE. Steps: Implement GET /rooms, POST /bookings with conflict check, and DELETE /bookings/:id. Assume local memory storage for simplicity. Done when: Postman or cURL proves that posting a duplicate time slot returns a 409 conflict error.
dependsOn: Define room and booking data schema

tasks.title: Create booking management dashboard
tasks.description: Deliverable: React UI components for room listing. Steps: Build component for displaying time slots and status. Implement 'Book' button trigger. Done when: User can toggle view between available rooms and see current selections.

tasks.title: Connect UI to backend API
tasks.description: Deliverable: Functioning end-to-end booking flow. Steps: Link frontend buttons to POST/DELETE requests. Ensure UI updates immediately after successful bookings. Done when: Clicking 'Book' updates the backend and refreshes the room availability display.

tasks.title: Verify cancellation logic
tasks.description: Deliverable: Evidence of restricted deletion. Steps: Ensure only the creator can cancel their booking. Attempt to cancel someone else's booking. Done when: Unauthorized cancel request returns 403 Forbidden and valid requests remove the record.

tasks.title: Write local setup guide
tasks.description: Deliverable: README.md file. Steps: Document node dependencies, setup command (e.g., npm install), and steps to launch server and client. Done when: A teammate confirms they can run the project locally following only these instructions.

milestones.title: Foundation Complete
milestones.description: API endpoints and basic dashboard UI are operational.

assignments.taskTitle: Define room and booking data schema

brief.description: Prepare a native-plant proposal for a shaded university courtyard. Deliver a comparison of suitable native plants, an annotated planting layout that keeps access paths clear, and a short presentation for the campus facilities team. This is a proposal only: no purchasing, planting, website, or software is required.

modules.name: Research and Analysis
modules.description: Gathering horticultural data for shaded courtyard environments.

modules.name: Design and Visualization
modules.description: Creating the visual layout and presentation materials.

tasks.title: Define site conditions and constraints
tasks.description: Deliverable: A summary document of shade levels (e.g., partial vs. deep), existing path dimensions, and soil assessment. Steps: Measure path widths; observe light patterns at mid-day; check university planting guidelines. Done when: Site constraints document is shared with Riya; path clearance requirements are explicitly defined.

tasks.title: Select native plants for shade
tasks.description: Deliverable: A comparison table of at least 5 native plant species suitable for shade. Steps: Research native species; confirm tolerance for shaded courtyard conditions; compare maintenance needs and height. Done when: Table is complete with justified recommendations for the university setting.

tasks.title: Draft annotated planting layout
tasks.description: Deliverable: A visual map showing where selected plants will go. Steps: Overlay plant footprints onto the courtyard map; verify paths remain at least 1.5m wide (assuming standard accessibility requirement); annotate layout for maintenance access. Done when: Layout clearly distinguishes between plant zones and clear transit paths.

tasks.title: Design facilities presentation
tasks.description: Deliverable: A 5-slide deck for the campus facilities team. Steps: Incorporate layout visual; summarize plant benefits; list maintenance needs; design clear, readable text. Done when: Presentation is reviewed for clarity on accessibility and ease of maintenance.

tasks.title: Peer review and final assembly
tasks.description: Deliverable: A polished, unified proposal document. Steps: Combine research and layout; check against university requirements; perform final edit for readability. Done when: Final proposal document is ready for handover to the university team.

tasks.title: Final project handover
tasks.description: Deliverable: Handover email and file storage. Steps: Organize final files; confirm file formats are accessible to the facilities team; send confirmation. Done when: Team confirms delivery receipt or successful upload to department portal.

milestones.title: Plant Selection Finalized
milestones.description: Validated list of shade-tolerant native species ready for design integration.

milestones.title: Proposal Ready for Delivery
milestones.description: Final planting layout and presentation deck prepared for university facilities team.
